capabilities: create carousel image galleries in notes using a code block
configure ordered image directories the plugin searches for image matches
insert gallery images via Obsidian file search without full paths
extras: README ends with a demonstration section whose content is not shown in the text.
problem: Embedding multiple images in a note clutters it, and Obsidian has no built-in way to group images into a compact carousel view.
summary: Gallery plugin that renders carousel image galleries in notes via a code block, searching configured image directories for matches.
